tldr: 台股週五重挫755.64點、約1.61%，收在46,184.85點，台積電、鴻海、聯發科等權值股領跌。
SEMICON Taiwan 2026 規模創新高，勤業眾信估2026年全球半導體營收上看9,750億美元、生成式AI晶片近5,000億美元。
金管會為壽險業接軌TIS鬆綁金控資本規範，並強化金檢警聯防、科技阻詐。
美股週五反彈，道瓊漲509點終止連四黑，油價降溫、市場消化8月CPI年增3.4%。
美債殖利率逼近多年高（10年期約4.96%），2026降息預期縮水，市場聚焦9月15至16日Fed會議。

items.title_zh: 權值科技股走弱　台股重挫755點
items.title_en: TAIEX tumbles 755 points as tech heavyweights weaken
items.summary_zh: 台股週五重挫，加權指數下跌755.64點、約1.61%，收在46,184.85點，成交量約7,200億元。台積電、鴻海、聯發科等權值科技股領跌，拖累大盤走弱。此波回檔反映高檔評價的獲利了結賣壓，以及市場對下週Fed會議的觀望心態；外資調節壓抑大型半導體族群，短線指數能否守穩月線與重要支撐，成為觀察後市多空的關鍵。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX fell sharply on Friday, dropping 755.64 points, or 1.61%, to close at 46,184.85 on turnover of roughly NT$720bn. Heavyweight tech names—TSMC, Hon Hai and MediaTek—led the decline and dragged the broader index lower. The pullback reflected profit-taking at elevated valuations and caution ahead of next week's Fed meeting, with foreign selling pressuring the large-cap semiconductor complex.

items.title_zh: 資金轉進光電　聯電爆大量
items.title_en: Money rotates into optoelectronics as UMC draws heavy volume
items.summary_zh: 在指數下挫之際，資金輪動轉進光電、資訊服務及部分電子零組件族群，成為盤面抗跌指標；聯電單日爆出逾11萬張大量，顯示籌碼積極換手。此輪動反映投資人調節過度擁擠的AI權值股，轉而尋找落後補漲的相對價值標的。大盤雖回檔，資金卻未全面退場，市場結構呈現強弱分化，類股比價效應與量能變化值得留意。
items.summary_en: Beneath the index drop, funds rotated into optoelectronics, information-service and selected component names, which held up as defensive pockets. United Microelectronics drew heavy volume of over 110,000 lots, a sign of active repositioning. The rotation underscored investors trimming crowded AI mega-caps while hunting relative value in laggard sectors, keeping market breadth uneven even as the headline index corrected.

items.title_zh: SEMICON展創新高　AI驅動晶片展望
items.title_en: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 opens at record scale as AI drives chip outlook
items.summary_zh: 國際半導體展SEMICON Taiwan 2026於台北登場，參展廠商達1,300家、攤位4,300個雙創新高，聚焦AI、矽光子與先進封裝等下一波主戰場。勤業眾信2026年展望估全球半導體營收上看9,750億美元、創歷史新高，其中生成式AI晶片營收接近5,000億美元，約占整體晶片銷售一半。展會凸顯台灣在AI硬體建置浪潮中的核心地位，供應鏈拉貨動能與先進製程投資動向備受市場關注。
items.summary_en: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 opened in Taipei with a record 1,300 exhibitors across 4,300 booths, spotlighting AI, silicon photonics and advanced packaging as the next battlegrounds. Deloitte's 2026 outlook sees global semiconductor revenue hitting a record US$975bn, with generative-AI chips approaching US$500bn—about half of all chip sales—underscoring Taiwan's central role in the AI hardware buildout.

items.title_zh: 勤業眾信籲台企掌握AI三大趨勢
items.title_en: Deloitte urges Taiwan firms to grasp three AI trends reshaping chips
items.summary_zh: 勤業眾信指出，AI正重塑半導體競爭版圖，呼籲台灣企業掌握三大趨勢：AI加速器需求爆發、先進封裝與高頻寬記憶體深度整合，以及矽光子與電源／散熱解決方案興起。輝達、美光、超微均在台投入大規模多年期投資，台灣供應鏈可望吃下更高比重的AI資本支出，從晶圓代工、封測到散熱與光通訊環節全面受惠，強化長線成長動能，惟須留意人才與產能瓶頸。
items.summary_en: Deloitte says AI is redrawing the semiconductor competitive map and urges Taiwanese firms to seize three trends: surging AI-accelerator demand, tighter integration of advanced packaging with high-bandwidth memory, and the push into silicon photonics and power/thermal solutions. With NVIDIA, Micron and AMD each committing large multi-year investments in Taiwan, the island's supply chain stands to capture a growing share of AI capex.

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁金控資本　助接軌TIS
items.title_en: FSC advances holding-company capital rules to ease TIS transition
items.summary_zh: 金管會銀行局預告「金融控股公司合併資本適足性管理辦法」修正草案，為壽險業2026年接軌新一代清償能力制度（TIS）鋪路。過渡措施下，8家壽險型金控可獲資本減壓，11家保險型金控適用資本適足率延後1個月申報。此舉在推動更嚴格清償標準的同時，緩解業者短期資本壓力與增資節奏，兼顧監理強度與產業穩定，攸關金控股評價與股利政策，市場密切關注過渡期效應。
items.summary_en: The FSC's banking bureau has pre-announced amendments to capital-adequacy rules for financial holding companies to smooth the industry's 2026 shift to the new-generation solvency regime (TIS). Under the transition, eight life-insurance-type holdings gain capital relief and 11 insurance-type holdings may defer their capital-adequacy filing by one month. The measures cushion near-term capital strain while phasing in tougher solvency standards.

items.title_zh: 科技阻詐　金管會強化金檢警聯防
items.title_en: FSC steps up anti-fraud drive with cross-agency "tech shield"
items.summary_zh: 金管會啟動「2026金檢警聯防：科技阻詐，全域守護高峰會」，結合金融監理與警政力量強化聯防，並提醒民眾勿透過未經核准在台設立據點之金融機構進行投資，以維自身權益。此舉針對線上詐騙與未經許可的跨境招攬加強防堵，在數位金融詐欺手法日益精密之際深化消費者保護，相關措施亦牽動金融機構法遵成本與KYC作業，提醒投資人審慎查證平台合法性。
items.summary_en: The FSC launched a 2026 anti-fraud summit uniting financial regulators and police under a "technology shield, whole-domain protection" banner, and reminded the public not to invest through financial institutions lacking approved local operations. The push tightens defenses around online scams and unlicensed cross-border solicitation, reinforcing consumer protection as digital-finance fraud grows more sophisticated.

items.title_zh: 推動亞洲資產管理中心　深化財管
items.title_en: Taiwan advances Asian asset-management hub via wealth-management plan
items.summary_zh: 台灣持續推進「亞洲資產管理中心」計畫，其中財富管理促進方案透過法規鬆綁，放寬銀行對資產達新台幣1億元以上高資產客戶提供更多元商品與跨境諮詢服務。政策目標在於引導海外資金回流、深化私人銀行、信託與結構型商品能力，並以高雄與台灣為據點打造家族辦公室與傳承規劃的區域樞紐。相關進展攸關本國銀行財管手續費收入成長與高端客群競爭，也牽動人才與商品貨架布局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan is pressing ahead with its Asian Asset Management Center initiative, whose wealth-management promotion plan loosens rules so banks can offer high-net-worth clients (assets above NT$100mn) a broader product menu and cross-border advisory. The policy aims to repatriate offshore wealth and deepen private-banking, trust and structured-product capabilities, positioning Taiwan as a regional hub for family-office and legacy planning.

items.title_zh: 高資產客戶爭奪戰升溫　私銀門檻1億
items.title_en: Banks vie for high-net-worth clients as private-banking bar sits at NT$100mn
items.summary_zh: 高資產客群爭奪戰升溫，外商與本土銀行—星展、匯豐、渣打，以及國泰、富邦、中信、玉山、永豐、台新—競相搶進。星展頂級私人客戶門檻設在新台幣1億元，各行同步擴充基金、ETF、債券與境外結構型商品貨架。此布局顯示財管模式加速轉向以手續費為基礎、顧問導向的經營，鎖定台灣富裕階層。銀行競逐高端市場，將牽動財管手續費收入、商品差異化與客戶資產配置趨勢，也考驗理財專員專業與法遵量能。
items.summary_en: Competition for wealthy clients is intensifying, with foreign and domestic banks—DBS, HSBC, Standard Chartered, plus Cathay, Fubon, CTBC, E.Sun, SinoPac and Taishin—vying for affluent customers. DBS Treasures Private Client sets a NT$100mn asset threshold, while banks broaden funds, ETFs, bonds and offshore structured products. The build-out signals a shift toward fee-based, advisory-led wealth models targeting affluent Taiwanese.

items.title_zh: 查詢遺產金融資料　國稅局單一窗口上路
items.title_en: Tax bureaus launch single window for inherited financial-asset inquiries
items.summary_zh: 自9月1日起，財政部各地區國稅局改由單一窗口回復查詢被繼承人金融遺產資料，繼承人不必再逐一向各金融機構申請。此一便民措施簡化流程、縮短遺產結算時程並減輕文件負擔，有助家屬與遺產管理人更有效率完成遺產稅申報與資產移轉。對高資產家庭而言，資料整合亦利於遺產規劃與稅務試算，降低漏報與爭議風險，後續配套與資訊介接情形值得留意。
items.summary_en: From September 1, Taiwan's regional national tax bureaus began responding to inquiries about a decedent's financial-asset data through a single window, so heirs no longer need to approach each financial institution separately. The streamlined service shortens estate-settlement timelines and eases documentation burdens, helping families and executors complete inheritance-tax filing and asset transfers more efficiently.

items.title_zh: 遺產及贈與稅法部分條文修正公布
items.title_en: Estate and gift tax law amendments promulgated
items.summary_zh: 總統公布遺產及贈與稅法部分條文修正，調整包括被繼承人死亡前2年內對特定親屬贈與之課稅處理等規定。修法使此類移轉併入遺產課稅的認定更明確、更嚴謹，牽動高資產家庭的遺產規劃、贈與時點安排與遺產稅負。納稅義務人宜留意生前贈與與傳承布局的稅務影響，及早檢視資產配置與保單、信託等工具，避免因規定調整而增加補稅與爭議風險。
items.summary_en: The President promulgated amendments to several articles of the Estate and Gift Tax Act, refining rules including the treatment of gifts made to specific relatives within two years before a decedent's death. The changes tighten and clarify how such transfers are counted into the taxable estate, affecting estate planning, timing of gifts and inheritance-tax exposure for high-net-worth families.

items.title_zh: CPI連四月破2%　主計總處估9月漲幅恐擴大
items.title_en: CPI tops 2% for a fourth month; DGBAS warns September may accelerate
items.summary_zh: 台灣消費者物價指數年增率已連續四個月站上2%，主計總處示警9月漲幅恐再擴大：9月上旬蔬菜批發價已升逾每公斤40元，高於8月均價約33.7元。外食與油料費仍為主要推力，物價壓力持續牽動決策關注，也影響央行下次理監事會的政策拿捏。對民生消費與實質購買力而言，蔬果與能源價格波動是短期通膨的關鍵變數，後續颱風與油價走勢值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's consumer inflation has stayed above 2% year over year for four straight months, and the DGBAS cautioned that September's increase could widen as vegetable prices climb—early-month wholesale prices rose above NT$40 per kg from an August average near NT$33.7. Dining-out and fuel costs remain the main drivers, keeping price pressure on policymakers' radar ahead of the next rate review.

items.title_zh: 主計總處研判「溫和上漲」　全年CPI估約1.93%
items.title_en: DGBAS still reads prices as "moderate", full-year CPI seen near 1.93%
items.summary_zh: 儘管近月數據破2%，主計總處研判整體物價屬「溫和上漲」，指1至8月平均CPI年增1.84%、仍低於2%，未見全面、顯著且持續的通膨特徵。官方全年CPI預估約1.93%，顯示在食物與能源價格帶來短期波動之際，貨幣政策傾向維持穩定。此一定調有助市場預期央行不急於升息，但若後續蔬果與油價漲勢延續，通膨評估與政策節奏仍有調整空間，牽動債市與匯率走向。
items.summary_en: Despite recent readings above 2%, the DGBAS characterizes overall prices as in "moderate increase", noting the January–August average CPI rose 1.84%, still under 2%, without the broad, large and persistent traits that define inflation. The agency's full-year CPI projection sits near 1.93%, signaling policy is likely to stay steady even as food and energy costs inject near-term volatility.

items.title_zh: 油價走高壓縮2026降息預期　Fed維持審慎
items.title_en: Oil spike shrinks 2026 rate-cut hopes as Fed stays cautious
items.summary_zh: 中東緊張推升的油價居高不下，使通膨黏著，市場大幅下修2026年降息押注，部分機構甚至示警升息風險。此一預期重估推升美債殖利率、收緊全球金融環境，對利率敏感的科技股與新興市場股市形成逆風，AI權值比重偏高的台股亦難置身事外。能源價格與Fed政策的拉鋸，成為左右全球資金流向與風險偏好的核心變數，牽動台股外資動向。
items.summary_en: Persistently elevated oil prices tied to Middle East tensions are keeping inflation sticky and forcing markets to slash bets on 2026 rate cuts, with some forecasters now flagging risk of a hike. The reassessment lifts Treasury yields and tightens global financial conditions, a headwind for rate-sensitive tech and emerging-market equities—including Taiwan's AI-heavy index.

items.title_zh: Fed九月決策　升息與按兵論戰
items.title_en: Fed's September decision splits forecasters between hike and hold
items.summary_zh: 在9月15至16日FOMC會議前，機構看法分歧：摩根大通預期升息1碼，認為能源驅動的通膨揮之不去；高盛則因勞動市場降溫、7月就業轉減而預期按兵不動。市場定價的升息機率在約28%至40%間擺盪，使全球股匯市高度受制於會議結果。對台股而言，Fed決策與殖利率走向將牽動外資進出與科技權值股評價，短線波動風險升高，投資人宜留意會前觀望氣氛。
items.summary_en: Ahead of the Sept 15–16 FOMC meeting, forecasters are divided: J.P. Morgan expects a 25-basis-point hike as energy-driven inflation lingers, while Goldman Sachs looks for a hold given a cooling labor market that shed jobs in July. Market-implied odds of a hike have swung between roughly 28% and 40%, leaving global equities and currencies hostage to the outcome.

items.title_zh: 美股週五反彈　道瓊漲509點終止連四黑 (2026-09-11)
items.title_en: US stocks rebound Friday, Dow up 509 points, snapping a four-day slide (2026-09-11)
items.summary_zh: 美股週五收高，終止連續四個交易日的跌勢，主因油價回落、美債殖利率止穩。道瓊上漲509.19點、約0.98%，收52,573.29點；標普500漲0.86%至7,656.98點；那斯達克綜合指數漲0.96%至26,333.04點。投資人在消化8月通膨數據後，樂見能源價格降溫，風險偏好回穩，惟市場對下週Fed決策仍保持觀望。
items.summary_en: Wall Street closed sharply higher on Friday, ending a four-session losing streak as crude oil retreated and Treasury yields steadied. The Dow rose 509.19 points, or 0.98%, to 52,573.29; the S&P 500 gained 0.86% to 7,656.98; and the Nasdaq Composite added 0.96% to 26,333.04. Investors welcomed a cooling in energy prices after digesting the August inflation report.

items.title_zh: 美8月CPI年增3.4%　升息押注升溫 (2026-09-11)
items.title_en: US August CPI rises 3.4% year over year as Fed rate-hike bets jump (2026-09-11)
items.summary_zh: 美國8月消費者物價指數經季調月增0.4%，年增率升至3.4%。數據偏強促使交易員上調Fed下週會議升息機率，先前對近期降息的信心隨之瓦解。能源成本黏著與服務類價格具韌性，使通膨回落路徑充滿不確定性。市場焦點轉向9月15至16日FOMC，通膨數據與利率預期的拉鋸，將牽動全球股債匯後續走勢與資金情緒。
items.summary_en: The August consumer price index rose a seasonally adjusted 0.4% on the month, lifting the annual rate to 3.4%. The firmer reading pushed traders to raise the odds of a Federal Reserve rate hike at next week's meeting, unwinding earlier confidence in near-term cuts. Sticky energy costs and resilient services prices kept the disinflation path uncertain heading into the FOMC.

items.title_zh: 美債殖利率逼近多年高　金價連三週下跌 (2026-09-11)
items.title_en: Treasury yields hover near multiyear highs; gold heads for third weekly loss (2026-09-11)
items.summary_zh: 美國10年期公債殖利率週五收在約4.96%、2年期約4.63%，在財政部買回操作不如預期後逼近多年高點；債市在週中震盪後止穩。金價受實質殖利率走高壓抑，本週料下跌近2%，為連續第三週收黑；殖利率上揚削弱不孳息資產吸引力。利率走升的環境對貴金屬與高評價成長股構成壓力，也牽動全球資金在避險與收益間的重新配置。
items.summary_en: The 10-year US Treasury yield finished around 4.96% and the 2-year near 4.63%, close to multiyear highs after a weaker-than-expected Treasury buyback. Bonds steadied on Friday after midweek volatility. Gold, pressured by rising real yields, was on track for a nearly 2% weekly loss—its third straight weekly decline—as higher rates dulled the appeal of non-interest-bearing assets.

items.title_zh: 甲骨文、博通攪動市場　AI交易迎現實檢驗 (2026-09-11)
items.title_en: Oracle and Broadcom rattle markets as the AI trade hits a reality check (2026-09-11)
items.summary_zh: 隨美債殖利率走高壓縮評價，投資人對AI族群轉趨選股。博通營收年增86%至295.9億美元，並重申2027會計年度AI營收上看逾1,000億美元；輝達則加速切入客製化AI晶片。甲骨文令市場不安的並非需求，而是AI晶片業務快速成長下的毛利壓力。這些訊號對台灣晶圓代工與封測供應鏈具直接連動，凸顯AI獲利品質與資本支出節奏成為評價關鍵，牽動相關權值股短線情緒。
items.summary_en: Investors are turning more selective on AI names as rising Treasury yields compress valuations. Broadcom's revenue surged 86% year over year to US$29.59bn and it reiterated fiscal-2027 AI revenue above US$100bn, while NVIDIA is pushing into custom AI silicon. Oracle unsettled markets not on demand but on margin pressure as AI-chip sales grow—signals watched closely by Taiwan's foundry and packaging chain.
